title: desmodium procumbens var. longipes
intro: Desmodium procumbens var. longipes, commonly known as the creeping tick trefoil, is a perennial herb belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium procumbens var. longipes include its ability to stimulate sweating, promote digestion, and act as a tonic for the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
